text:
Type: armless lounge easy chair
Use: relaxing, reading; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, mid-century modern
Materials: bent birch veneer frame, grey perforated mesh seat shell
Colors: light grey, light natural birch
Shape: one-piece curved seat and back shell sloping low, armless, open wooden frame with square legs and side stretchers, light and airy, compact
Feel: relaxed, light, casual, fresh
Goes with: light wood, white walls, grey textiles; Scandinavian living rooms, small apartments, student rooms

product.name: NOLMYRA
product.description: The armchair is lightweight and easy to move if you want to clean the floor or rearrange the furniture.
